pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

body.desc: the round pink bomb body; root card, pivot at its foot (0, 2)

face.desc: the eyes: white ovals with low dark pupils and lashes; a face layer over the body, pivot at (0, 6) like the body's centre line

face_blink.desc: eyes shut, lashes down; a face layer over the body, pivot at (0, 6) like the body's centre line

face_hurt.desc: eyes squeezed shut (> <); a face layer over the body, pivot at (0, 6) like the body's centre line

face_talk.desc: eyes open with a blush under them (the shy lines); a face layer over the body, pivot at (0, 6) like the body's centre line

fuse.desc: the metal fuse cap with the wick and a red bow tied round it; pivot at the cap's foot, sunk into the body's top (0, 16)

spark.desc: the lit fuse's spark; sits on the wick's tip (0.75, 22.5) and flickers (scale, spin)

key.desc: the wind-up key: spins round its shaft; pivot at the shaft's root, in the body's back

foot_front.desc: the front foot: a round orange shoe; pivot at its top, under the body

foot_back.desc: the back foot, a tone darker: a round orange shoe; pivot at its top, under the body

rest_note: model_xy is each card's pivot at rest
